Spectral analysis
We can now derive specific spectral properties of the
Koopman operator that we will leverage for state estima-
tion. Those properties require the following additional
assumptions on the nonlinear system (6).
Assumption 3 (stable hyperbolic equilibrium).
The dynamics admits a stable equilibrium at the ori-
gin, whose basin of attraction contains the polydisc
Dn. Moreover, the eigenvalues λj of the Jacobian ma-
trix JF (0) are simple and satisfy Re(λj) < 0 for all
j = 1, . . . , n.
